images.prompt: A mobile-friendly cover infographic for a Chinese financial history article about the 1907 New York banking panic. Foreground: a large clear scene of depositors queuing outside a 1907 trust company building, bank door half-closed, vintage newspaper headline silhouettes hinting at 'one man saved the market' but kept small and blurred. Background: abstract coordination diagram—a round decision table, ledgers, and 2-3 arrows from multiple generic bank icons converging on a central decision window. NO identifiable historical person, NO single giant personal check, NO wallet held by one hero figure. Restrained journal style, muted warm gray and sepia, cinematic but not sensational. Large clear Chinese headline text centered upper area: 「危机里先缺的不是钱包」. Optional small corner text: 「1907 · 纽约」. No English text, no watermark, no Fed founding celebration, no conspiracy shadows.
